items.exampleEn: A long, gray winter can bring a feeling of lethargy.
items.exampleZh: 漫長陰沉的冬天可能會讓人感到倦怠無力。

items.exampleEn: The tedium of filling out forms made him want to quit.
items.exampleZh: 填表格的單調乏味讓他想放棄。

items.exampleEn: The nurse received a commendation for her quick thinking.
items.exampleZh: 那位護理師因反應機敏而獲得表揚。

items.exampleEn: Such rude behavior toward customers is inexcusable.
items.exampleZh: 對客人那麼無禮的行為是不可原諒的。
items.glossZh: 不可原諒的；無法辯解的

items.exampleEn: She gave a scornful laugh when he offered to help.
items.exampleZh: 他說要幫忙時，她輕蔑地笑了一聲。

items.exampleEn: The film's zany humor is perfect for children.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影滑稽古怪的幽默很適合小孩。

items.exampleEn: Babies salivate a lot when their first teeth are coming in.
items.exampleZh: 嬰兒長第一顆牙時，口水會流得很多。

items.exampleEn: She told the story with great verve and humor.
items.exampleZh: 她說起那個故事來既生動有勁又幽默。

items.sentenceEn: The dog began to salivate as soon as it heard the food bag.
items.sentenceZh: 那隻狗一聽到飼料袋的聲音就開始流口水。

items.audioEn: Forgetting your best friend's wedding is simply inexcusable, no matter how busy you are.
items.audioZh: 不管你有多忙，忘了最好朋友的婚禮就是不可原諒。
items.questionZh: 說話者認為忘了好友的婚禮怎麼樣？
options: It is fine if you are really busy

items.sentenceEn: Her scornful remarks hurt the whole team.
items.sentenceZh: 她輕蔑的言論傷了整個團隊的心。

items.sentenceEn: On Sunday, a deep lethargy kept me in bed until noon.
items.sentenceZh: 星期天，一股濃濃的倦怠感讓我在床上賴到中午。

items.stemEn: Only his sense of humor saved us from the ____ of the six-hour meeting.
items.stemZh: 只有他的幽默感，讓我們撐過了六小時會議的單調乏味。

items.stemEn: Being late is one thing, but lying about it is ____.
items.stemZh: 遲到是一回事，但為此說謊就不可原諒了。

items.passageEn: For years, the Sunday show at our community theater suffered from tedium: the same old plays, performed with little energy. Then a new director arrived with zany ideas, such as a play in which the actors cooked real soup in front of the audience. The smell made people salivate, and the actors' antics kept everyone laughing. The cast performed with such verve that even a critic who had been scornful of local theater wrote a warm review. Not everything went smoothly: one actor arrived an hour late on opening night, which the director called inexcusable. Still, by the end of the season the group had shaken off its old lethargy and even received a commendation from the city council.
items.passageZh: 多年來，我們地方小劇場的週日演出一直很沉悶：老是那幾齣戲，演得也沒什麼活力。後來來了一位新導演，帶來許多古怪有趣的點子，例如有一齣戲讓演員在觀眾面前真的煮湯。香味讓大家直流口水，演員的滑稽動作也讓全場笑聲不斷。演員們演得活力十足，連一位一向瞧不起地方劇場的評論家都寫了一篇好評。不過並非一切順利：首演當晚，一位演員遲到了一個小時，導演說這是不可原諒的。儘管如此，到了這一季結束時，劇團已經擺脫了過去的倦怠，甚至獲得市議會的表揚。

questions.questionZh: 新導演帶來了什麼樣的點子？
options: 把舊劇本改成音樂劇演出
請知名演員來客串演出主角

questions.questionZh: 這一季結束時，劇團得到了什麼？
options: 一筆來自企業的大額贊助
到國外巡迴演出的機會

items.promptZh: 我叔叔總是能想出一些古怪又好笑的點子。
referenceEn: My uncle always comes up with zany ideas.
My uncle always has some zany and funny ideas.
rubricZh: 「古怪又好笑的」用 zany，放在名詞前（例如 zany ideas）
「想出」可寫，例如 comes up with、has、thinks of 等
說的是習慣，時態配合內容（例如 comes up with、has）

items.promptZh: 這位消防員因為救出受困的小貓而獲得表揚。
referenceEn: The firefighter received a commendation for rescuing a trapped kitten.
The firefighter was given a commendation for saving a kitten that was stuck.
rubricZh: 「表揚」用 commendation（例如 received a commendation for… 等）
「救出受困的小貓」可寫，例如 rescuing a trapped kitten、saving a kitten that was stuck 等
時態配合內容（例如 received、was given 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：疑似一眼排除（干擾項詞性與其他選項不同）
執行長第②③關裁示修正：選項釋義同步
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 ["不可原諒的","滑稽古怪的","輕蔑的","令人羨慕的"]（原 ["不可原諒的","滑稽古怪的","輕蔑的","倦怠"]）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關＋第③關 2-E：刪去「可數名詞」、改用「例如」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長裁示修正（3-C 第 17 條：同單元不同課不重複同一情境）：①午餐後提不起勁重複（u38-l08 q09 保留），改成週日賴床（避開 u38-l04 球隊表現平平、u38-l10 長途飛行的情境）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 On Sunday, a deep lethargy kept me in bed until noon.（原 After lunch, a wave of lethargy came over the whole office.）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長裁示修正（3-C 第 17 條：同單元不同課不重複同一情境）：中譯同步
